body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Thomson presented a headphone with built-in mp3 player. It features 1GB memory capacity to store 300 mp3 files. It is compatible with iPod shuffle and expected to be available in February.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Niki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Sirh >
